title: Their wedding
summary: They married at City Hall, then in a Protestant church and finally the Catholic church for the children's schools.

blocks.x: Okay. Where did you get married in?
We went to the City Hall and then we saw one

of those church, Protestant or Episcopal, I don't know, that they give you beautiful title with birds and flowers and said, let's get married here, so we got married there and then we went one day to another church and we got married so then the kids start coming and they went to Catholic school, you got to marry in church, whatever, so we got married.......
